text:
samir-sec: Heads up — certs for edge-proxy in eu-west-1 and ap-south are showing expiry within 6 days. Also seeing KMS permission errors during rotation attempts. Need a quick sync on mTLS rotation policy + audit logging so we don't have a cross-region outage.

matt-sre: I'm oncall. Can you paste the cert-checker output and relevant logs?

samir-sec: Output from cert-checker (just the relevant lines):
```
edge-proxy.eu-west-1.internal.local - expires 2026-04-02T03:12:18Z (5d)
edge-proxy.ap-south-1.internal.local - expires 2026-04-03T11:05:06Z (6d)
cert-rotator.ap-south-1.svc - last-renew: 2026-03-26T22:14:00Z - status: failed
```

samir-sec: And the rotation job logs show repeated KMS failures:
```
2026-03-26T22:14:02Z cert-rotator[pid:324] ERROR: kms.Decrypt: AccessDeniedException: Permission denied for key arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
    status=403 request_id=xyz-789
```

jenna-eng: Is cert-manager running with the right service account? We rolled an RBAC change last week for the cert-rotator SA in ap-south to tighten permissions.

kevin-pm: That was me — I scoped down cert-rotator so it couldn't access staging KMS keys anymore (we thought it only needed local CA). Didn't realize production rotation in ap-south still used the CMK for decrypting the CSR private key.

matt-sre: Ok, root cause looks like RBAC change + KMS CMK policy mismatch. Immediate mitigation steps I propose:
1) Re-add the rolebinding to restore cert-rotator->kms-decrypter for ap-south (temp allow).
2) Manually trigger renewals for the two expiring certs and push to canary proxies.
3) Add additional alerting for cert expiry <7d and failed KMS decrypts.
4) Run a full KMS audit to capture all decrypt attempts for the last 48h.

samir-sec: Agreed. Also we should update the runbook: rotation job must preflight KMS decrypt with a dry-run and fail early with clear error if permissions missing.

jenna-eng: I'll create a quick preflight script and patch the cert-rotation job. Example preflight snippet: 
```bash
# preflight.sh
aws kms.decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:${REGION}:${ACCOUNT}:key/${CMK_ID} || exit 1
```
This will surface 403s before we actually attempt CSR operations.

matt-sre: Also, for TLS hardening while we're touching proxies: disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and force TLS_ECDHE... ciphers. Central config patch:
```yaml
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers 'ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:...';
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
```
We should roll this with a canary in eu-west-1 first.

kevin-pm: For longer term: update RBAC change checklist to include a KMS access audit and a cross-region impact analysis. I missed that in the last change.

samir-sec: Agree. Also adding KMS audit logging to the rotation critical path: capture principal, key-id, operation (Decrypt), request_id and include it in our security logs for 90 days. We should ensure these get shipped to sec-logs index with proper retention.

rotation-bot: Alert created: cert-expiry-eu-west-1 (severity=high) -> paging matt-sre, samir-sec :rotating_light:

matt-sre: I'm going to open a short-lived incident and follow the mitigation plan. Steps I'll run now: rebind role -> trigger renew -> confirm proxy reload.

deploy-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-0459 - "Edge proxy cert rotation failure / KMS access denied (ap-south-1)". Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/cert-rotation-runbook

jenna-eng: After we patch RBAC I'll push the preflight and add a CI job that simulates rotation against a dummy CMK in each region. That will catch this class of issue in PRs.

samir-sec: One more follow-up: encryption-in-transit checklist for this response:
- RBAC: verify service account rolebindings across regions (list attached)
- KMS: verify CMK key policy includes cert-rotator principal and log all Decrypt calls
- TLS: enforce TLSv1.2+ and forward secrecy ciphers, HSTS where applicable
- Alerting: expiry <7d + KMS decrypt 5xx/403s -> pagerduty escalation
- Postmortem: short writeup linking RBAC change PR + missing impact assessment

kevin-pm: I'll own the postmortem and checklist update. Will post PR for RBAC checklist changes after incident is closed.

matt-sre: Done initial mitigation: rolebinding restored in ap-south, retriggered rotation job, certs renewed and canary proxies in ap-south are serving new certs. Monitoring for TLS handshake errors for the next hour.

samir-sec: Nice work. Once incident is stable we should also schedule a KMS policy review to ensure cross-account principals and regional roles are explicit (no wildcard ARNs).

jenna-eng: Remind me to add a lint rule to our infra repo that flags RBAC changes which remove kms:Decrypt from cert-rotator SA in any region.

matt-sre: Closing loop: will leave alerts on for 72h and then transition to postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
